trending_videos.title: WICKER | Official Trailer | 2026 [HD]
trending_videos.description:
A hard man is good to find. 
 
In a seaside village lost to time, a fisherwoman (Olivia Coleman) delivers the food relied on by the townsfolk, who barely tolerate her cantankerous presence. Unexpectedly named the next to be wed and sick of the disdain, she commissions the local Basketmaker (Peter Dinklage) to weave her the perfect husband (Alexander Skarsgård) and he truly goes above and beyond. When you’re married to the hottest and handiest man around, jealousies inevitably flare up.

WICKER releases nationwide across Australia (November 26) & New Zealand (January 7).
